spot_vs_futures.identity: futures excess return ~ spot change + (y - u - r) per year; spot minus cash ~ spot change - r; difference = net convenience yield (y - u): positive in backwardation, negative in contango
spot_vs_futures.sign_error_rule_of_thumb: with 12-month spot changes ~ N(0, 25%), a net carry of c flips the 12-month sign in about c / (0.25 sqrt(2 pi)) of months: 8% at c = 5%/yr, 16% at 10%, 32% at 20% (reasoning); VALIDATE's 90% agreement gate would fail for |c| above about 6%/yr
spot_vs_futures.averaging: monthly-average spot (World Bank, IMF) adds positive autocorrelation (Working 1960, reasoning) that biases a trend test upward
spot_vs_futures.validation: a 2003+ (spent) futures-vs-spot check is possible (pysystemtrade futures against FRED daily WTI and Henry Hub spot, the World Bank monthly file) but would not carry over: the basis regime of 2003-2024 (energy contango, financialisation) differs from 1960-2002. Not needed for the main read: free futures exist from 1969-70
spot_vs_futures.recommendation: use futures, not spot; spot only as a labelled benchmark
